prompt:
Use case: stylized-concept. Asset type: DRAFT FOR OWNER REVIEW, one composite character identity sheet for the 2D CRPG Soul Meter. This explores unratified visual choices and establishes no canon.
Style/medium: gothic mythopunk; semi-realistic painted digital character illustration matching the Soul Meter Vex, Old Grumbrand, Korrath Ninefold and Ressa Quickfingers imagegen-source art: tactile worn materials, fine visible painterly grain, continuous tonal grade, believable volume and weight, muted Earth palette, charcoal and peat shadows, warm stone and cloth, restrained local accents. Like a painted classic CRPG character, never a flat graphic, UI icon, vector, cel cartoon, photograph or clean 3D render.
Lighting: single directional key light from upper-left with rich continuous shaded falloff; readable silhouettes, no pure-black outline. Background: opaque neutral mid-grey parchment, subtly textured, no environment, no transparent or checkerboard or green-screen ground.
Output: ONE composite PNG in landscape orientation, largest native landscape resolution the tool supports, full resolution. Keep all subjects fully inside margins with feet visible. No panels resembling UI. No lettering, captions, numbers, pseudo-writing, logos, watermarks or music notation, except the single word PROVISIONAL beside the scale bar on race sheets only. No bright generic high fantasy, no chibi/cartoon proportions, no flat lighting, no steampunk-dominant costume, no firearms, no Age-of-Stars machines, no Hollow bodies. Do not depict any deity. No extra image.
Composition: TWO large full-body healthy adult mortal race bases wearing the SAME CLASS KIT family, one on the left, the other on the right, at a gently elevated three-quarter/isometric-adjacent view, fully grounded and readable with feet visible. Between them, neatly spaced painted object studies show the canon weapon(s), the ONE regalia piece and the ONE identifying mark/accessory; include all canon auxiliary tools without inventing extra weapon classes. Every object is paint, not a flat vector. Neutral undyed working undershirt/trousers under kit; the kit attaches to anatomy and NEVER changes it. No helmets hiding race faces. No extra whole-body character, deity, image panel, scale bar, text, numbers, captions, lettering or pseudo-writing at all. Landscape composite, largest native resolution.
Class: Ironbrand; patron association Kero only, never a deity depiction. Canon kit: Greatsword or spiked gauntlet, ritual branding.
LEFT wearer: orthos — upright adult DRACONIC humanoid with short wedge muzzle and stepped brow plates, slate-olive scales, low swept-back horn ridges, muscular low tail, long forearms and broad clawed feet, NO WINGS, no machinery.
RIGHT wearer: ghorr — massive almost-ursine torso, coarse peat-brown fur, warthog muzzle with one lower tusk per side, EXACTLY FOUR ARMS arranged in two strong pairs and four separately visible padded hands, plantigrade feet; upper arms at collar and lower below ribs, neither pair is a stump.
Allowed colour treatment: Sunset Orange / Robin's Egg Blue, muted rust-orange and dusty blue-grey.
Canon alternatives, not new weapons: GREATSW0RD (no lettering) and SPIKED GAUNTLET. Ghorr upper arm pair grips one heavy greatsword with visibly cauterized rejoined steel seam; both lower arms empty, open and visible, never amputated or hidden. Orthos wears the alternative spiked gauntlet on one hand, other hand visible and empty; central weapon study presents sword and gauntlet as separate alternatives, no double-equipped invention. Exactly one regalia piece: heavy riveted breastplate fitted for each anatomy, hammer-scale steel, deliberately repaired welds, tiny muted rust-orange and dusty robin-egg blue-grey cloth insets. One mark: a narrow forearm leather band with proud counted geometric brand impressions, non-alphabetic, no readable letters and no open wounds. Scar-ledger, earned weight, no gore, no decorative blood. Ghorr exactly FOUR arms, Orthos strongly draconic and wingless.
5. Avoid-list: pure-black outlines, flat/even lighting, cartoon/chibi proportions, bright
   generic high fantasy, steampunk-dominant material language, baked text/UI.
